differences: The paper text in the deposit's script gives a mean UPDRS motor score of 31 (SD 15); the demographics file gives 30.45 (SD 14.8), so the mean was not used as a published check.

The script reports 9 participants with an EAT-10 of 3 or more and 18 with an unrestricted diet; the demographics file gives 10 and 16 (FOIS 7) by the obvious cut-offs, so these were not used as checks.
participant_calibration_factors.csv (belt calibration, 23 rows) and the reliability files are not carried over.
Trials the authors excluded for extraneous movement have empty lung volume or flow values in cough_data.csv and give no row for that measure.
